theme: 3 terms on standard-library protocols: listing enum cases, identifying items in a list, and customizing printed text

terms.definition: A protocol that lets a type list all of its cases in `allCases`, so you can loop over every case of an enum.
terms.example: `Size` is CaseIterable, so I can loop over `Size.allCases` for the picker.

terms.definition: A protocol that gives each value a stable `id`, so lists can tell items apart.
terms.example: `User` is Identifiable, so the list can use its `id` to track each row.

terms.definition: A protocol that lets a type control the text that `print` shows for its values.
terms.example: I made `Pet` CustomStringConvertible, so `print` shows a clear name in the log.

quizzes.question: In this code, which protocol gives `User` a stable `id`?

video.title: CaseIterable, Identifiable & CustomStringConvertible | Day 32
video.description:
Learn to explain how Swift lists enum cases, identifies items and prints your types: CaseIterable, Identifiable & CustomStringConvertible, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
CaseIterable - A protocol that lets a type list all of its cases in `allCases`, so you can loop over every case of an enum.
Identifiable - A protocol that gives each value a stable `id`, so lists can tell items apart.
CustomStringConvertible - A protocol that lets a type control the text that `print` shows for its values.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: Swift CaseIterable, Identifiable & CustomStringConvertible | Day 32
landscape.description:
Explain CaseIterable, Identifiable & CustomStringConvertible in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
케이스 이터러블, 아이덴티파이어블, 커스텀 스트링 컨버터블 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

CaseIterable - A protocol that lets a type list all of its cases in `allCases`, so you can loop over every case of an enum.
한국어: 케이스 이터러블: enum의 모든 case를 `allCases`로 나열할 수 있게 해 주는 프로토콜

Identifiable - A protocol that gives each value a stable `id`, so lists can tell items apart.
한국어: 아이덴티파이어블: 각 값에 고유한 `id`를 부여해 목록에서 항목을 구분할 수 있게 해 주는 프로토콜

CustomStringConvertible - A protocol that lets a type control the text that `print` shows for its values.
한국어: 커스텀 스트링 컨버터블: `print`가 보여 주는 텍스트를 직접 정할 수 있게 해 주는 프로토콜

landscape.hook: Can you explain these protocol terms in English?

dialogue.title: Why is the log plain?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, why does the log say `Tab.home` as plain text?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because I did not set `description` yet. I need CustomStringConvertible.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. With CustomStringConvertible, `print` shows your own text.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: OK, I return the `rawValue` with a label. Now it shows `Tab: home`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. I want a button per tab. Can I loop over them?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Wait, I thought CaseIterable also gives each tab an `id`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: My mistake. It only lists cases. Identifiable gives the `id`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Identifiable lets a list tell tabs apart by `id`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. I return the `rawValue` as the `id`, so it is stable.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Perfect. CaseIterable for the loop, Identifiable for the list.
Make it CaseIterable, and `allCases` lists every case.
